steps: Create constrained profile, extrude, hole pattern
Change length 80 to 100 mm and regenerate
Save/reopen both revisions; compare feature dependencies
positive_controls: All four holes survive regeneration; volume within chosen 0.01 mm3 tolerance
negative_controls: Self-intersecting profile and diameter wider than stock must not silently produce a valid solid
workflows.purchase_boundary: V5 Part Design configuration NOT_VERIFIED; xDesign included parametric description; Design store modeling tiers; Designcenter Standard core. Equivalent command compatibility not assumed.

inputs: Reference boundary curves and selected 0.01 mm positional tolerance
steps: Create/freeform edit surfaces in the licensed surface tool
Measure positional/tangent/curvature continuity independently
Modify one boundary and round-trip/reopen
outputs: G0/G1/G2 measurement record with sample locations
positive_controls: Meeting fixture continuity retained after reopen
negative_controls: Introduce 0.1 mm gap and tangent break; report failure rather than smooth appearance
workflows.purchase_boundary: V5 shape and CATIA advanced surfaces need exact licenses; xDesign subdivision description is different technology, not equivalent Class-A proof.

inputs: Two 10 mm cubes, second offset 8 mm along X
steps: Installed SOLIDWORKS: Tools / Evaluate / Interference Detection
Select components/options in PropertyManager; Calculate
Inspect Results volume/component names; export spreadsheet; retain option state
outputs: Interference pair and 200 mm3 reference overlap
positive_controls: One actual overlap of 200 mm3; full pair names, not a viewport proxy
negative_controls: 12 mm offset has no overlap; ignored interference must not be silently counted as clean geometry
workflows.purchase_boundary: Documented installed SOLIDWORKS command. No xDesign command mapping or DoF/large-assembly result inferred; verify licensed installed product before execution.

inputs: Three dimensions and one datum/GDT reference
steps: Designcenter Convert to PMI for selected sheet/views/annotations
Read conversion summary and inspect resulting model views/PMI
Convert whole drawing separately; revise model and compare semantic references
outputs: Selected versus full conversion object inventory
positive_controls: Selection inventory matches documented conversion scope; no orphan semantic references
negative_controls: Unselected sheet remains unconverted; broken model reference must be reported, not only a visible label
workflows.purchase_boundary: Designcenter MBD conversion described, exact module/core entitlement must be verified. CATIA annotation role and xDesign drawings are not proven equivalent converters.

inputs: 1.5 mm sheet, 2 mm inside bend radius, 90 degree bend
steps: Create flange/bend in licensed sheet tool
Unfold and record bend sequence
Refold, alter thickness, regenerate and reopen
positive_controls: Fixture allowance and constant thickness within chosen tolerance
negative_controls: Self-overlapping flange or contradictory bend rule cannot export a silent valid flat
workflows.purchase_boundary: CATIA specialized app/add-on versus xDesign included tools and Design store all-tier tools. K-factor convention is this protocol, not vendor documentation.

inputs: Two identical profiles with different lengths
Stable part IDs and cut dimensions
steps: Create members, trims and joints using structure tool
Revise one length and generate cut list/BOM where licensed
Save/reopen; reconcile lengths, IDs and quantities
outputs: BOM/cut-list if supported by separately verified command
positive_controls: Member count and cut lengths reconcile with geometry
negative_controls: Duplicate ID and absent profile cannot quietly yield a complete cut list
workflows.purchase_boundary: xDesign official article supports edges/sketches/curves, trims and cut-list workflow; Design store tools described. CATIA Body Structure and composites are distinct roles. Full BOM-specific command documentation still NOT_VERIFIED.

inputs: Drafted cavity with one 0.8 mm wall
Explicitly licensed CAM and approved machine postprocessor
steps: Check draft/wall thickness and create mold geometry
Generate toolpath only in verified CAM entitlement
Simulate stock removal; compare coordinates and approved post output offline
outputs: Toolpath/stock residual if CAM separately licensed
Approved-post provenance, not production machine motion
positive_controls: Thin wall flagged; tool/stock coordinate records reconciled
negative_controls: Missing CAM license, wrong postprocessor or tool-stock collision must fail, not emit production-ready claim
workflows.purchase_boundary: CATIA DFM add-ons and V5 CAM portfolio; xDesign mold geometry only; Design NC card does not name all CAM modules. Never operate a production machine in this research.

steps: Bind material/units/support/load in licensed linear solver
Solve three mesh refinements
Compare tip displacement with PL^3/(3EI); retain solver/mesh provenance
positive_controls: Reaction balances load; convergence towards chosen analytic tolerance
negative_controls: Unconstrained rigid body and mixed units must not yield silent validated physics
workflows.purchase_boundary: Design Premium linear-static card is bounded; Designcenter CAD simulation requires module check. No nonlinear, CFD or physical certification inferred.

inputs: Two connectors, three segments, fixed route IDs
Pipe diameter and minimum bend radius
steps: Create logical endpoints and physical route in licensed routing role
Change connector location and regenerate
Reconcile path continuity, bend radius, length and connectivity
positive_controls: Every segment connects expected endpoints and preserves IDs
negative_controls: Disconnected terminal, too-small bend and obstacle crossing must be reported
workflows.purchase_boundary: CATIA building/civil electrical and fluid are separate roles; Design Premium routing card; Designcenter routed-systems module inclusion NOT_VERIFIED. Not hydraulic/EM simulation evidence.

inputs: Part revision A/B, assembly references A
Two authorized test users and one nonmember
steps: Save revision A, revise to B, preserve assembly revision binding
Share read/modify rights in separately entitled service
Reopen revisions and record simultaneous-edit/recovery behavior without production writes
outputs: Recovery result if explicitly authorized and supported
positive_controls: Saved A remains readable and assembly binding is explicit
negative_controls: Nonmember read and read-only write denied; stale concurrent update not silent overwrite
workflows.purchase_boundary: xDesign storage/revisions and CATIA access descriptions, Connected role-based entitlement. Enterprise PLM transactions/security/recovery not certified; no real accounts or production changes here.

not_verified: SOLIDWORKS Connected-specific role and deployment mapping
industrial_comparison.rule: A feature name, upstream library capability, or a captured marketing statement is not an OpenCAD industrial acceptance result.
